locations.title: Locations (ISO-2 codes)
locations.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to fetch per-country top domains for. Example: US, DE, JP. Empty = skip per-country calls.

categories.title: Domain categories
categories.description: Cloudflare Radar category names to filter by (e.g. Technology, Business, News & Media). Empty = auto-discover the full category list via a warm-up API call, then iterate all of them.

rankingType.title: Ranking type
rankingType.description: Which Cloudflare Radar ranking to pull.

limit.title: Top N per combination
limit.description: How many top domains to fetch per (location, category) combination. Default 1 returns just the #1 domain for each pair.

date.title: Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
date.description: Optional. Leave empty for the most recent data (rankings refresh daily).

includeGlobal.title: Include global ranking
includeGlobal.description: Also fetch the global (no-location) top domain for each category.
